name: Sursi
description: Place on Dominaria where Serra was murdered.

description_citations.text: "Serra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra is attacked in Sursi by a black-aligned planeswalker, wastes away, and sanctifies the land.
timeline.quote: She used her last strength to sanctify the land around Sursi.

citation.text: "Serra", section "Murdered in Sursi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Legend holds a Mesa Pegasus appears to a pure-hearted bride in Sursi, blessing her family.
timeline.quote: Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear

citation.text: Mesa Pegasus (Rivals Quick Start Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A village where a woman visits the land of the Mesa Pegasus before marrying.
